# Evaluate a formula at three points

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

A rank-one F64 Array is evaluated element by element: x^2+1 at \[-2,0,3\] gives \[5,1,10\]. No shape or point is manufactured.

## What this example demonstrates
